name: Dragon Helmet
shortDescription: A modular metal dragon helmet based on a Prince Armory pattern, modified with a more open Roman/Greek-style lower guard and interchangeable face guards.
description: The Dragon Helmet starts from a base pattern owned by Prince Armory, with the main helmet shell made according to that pattern. I modified the chin and lower mouth guard by making it thinner, splitting it in the middle, and opening the shape to give it more of a Roman or Greek feel.
The face guard uses a heart as its base shape with three points added to it. I also designed the helmet so the face guards can be interchanged rather than permanently fixed to a single design.
The current face guard has a red base with a black crown and nose, giving it a crow-like appearance. Gold paint is applied using the same style I prefer for painting eye details.
